request.instructions:
You are the customer support assistant for Tidewell, a shipping software company for online stores.

Help the customer with their question. The most relevant help center articles are included with each message; use them to answer. Be friendly and concise.

Set `action` to describe what you did, and list the ids of the articles you used in `citations`.

input.content:
<help_center_articles>
<article id="lost-or-damaged-packages" title="Lost or damaged packages" updated="2026-07-01">
Carriers are responsible for packages in transit. Without Shipping Protection, claims for lost or damaged packages must be filed directly with the carrier.

Shipping Protection is an optional add-on that costs $1.25 per $100 of declared value, with a minimum of $1.25 per package. It covers up to $5,000 per package.

Shipping Protection claims must be filed within 30 days of the ship date from Shipments > File a claim. A package is considered lost if it has no tracking updates for 10 days (domestic) or 20 days (international).

Approved claims are paid within 7 business days to your original payment method.
</article>

<article id="international-customs" title="International shipping and customs" updated="2026-06-12">
Tidewell fills in customs forms (CN22 or CN23) automatically for international USPS shipments, using the product details from your store.

Add an HS tariff code to each product to avoid delays. Shipments without HS codes may be held by customs.

Delivered Duty Paid (DDP), where you prepay duties and taxes for your customer, is available with DHL Express only.

Tidewell cannot ship lithium batteries, aerosols or perfume internationally.
</article>

<article id="returns-portal" title="Returns portal" updated="2026-06-30">
The returns portal lets your customers start a return and print a prepaid return label themselves. It is available on the Growth and Scale plans.

You choose who pays for return postage: the store, or the customer (deducted from their refund in your store platform).

Return labels are only charged when the carrier scans them. Unused return labels cost nothing.

Returns can be limited to a window you set, from 7 to 90 days after delivery.
</article>
</help_center_articles>

<customer_message>
How much does shipping protection cost for a $300 package?
</customer_message>

reply.description: The message shown to the customer.
reply.title: Reply

action.description: answer: answered from the articles. clarify: asked a clarifying question. handoff: routing to a human agent. refuse: declined an off-topic or disallowed request. dont_know: the articles do not contain the answer.
action.title: Action

citations.description: Ids of the articles the reply relies on. Empty if none.
citations.title: Citations

parsed.reply: Shipping Protection for a $300 package costs $3.75.
